name: Security Creation Status Advice V 01
definition: SCOPE|An executing/servicing party sends a SecurityCreationStatusAdvice message to an instructing party to report the status of a SecurityCreationRequest message previously sent by the instructing party. ||The SecurityCreationStatusAdvice message may be sent as a response to the request of the instructing party or not.||The instructing party - executing/servicing party relationship may be:|- Central Securities Depositories (CSD) who would like to publish security static data, or |- a Corporate, or|- a Bank, or|- a Market Infrastructure, or |- a Market Data Provider.||USAGE|Initiator: executing/servicing party.
